text:
zoe: tiny thoughtheading into travel season  what 3-song "pre-binge" sequence do you put on before starting a TV show on a long flight? say the show too. keep it short. :airplane:

carlos: love this. mine: 1) Lykke Li - "I Follow Rivers" 2) Tame Impala - "Retrograde" 3) Hot Chip - "Over and Over". show: The Expanse. helps me wake up between tense scenes.

priya: 1) Massive Attack - "Teardrop" 2) FKA twigs - "Cellophane" 3) Nils Frahm - "Says". show: Dark (German). sets the mood for slow dread.

luke: three that's more comedic: 1) The Go! Team - "Huddle Formation" 2) Beck - "Loser" 3) Clairo - "Bags". show: Ted Lasso. immediate energy and then calm. :soccer:

nancy: thriller flight kit: 1) Burial - "Archangel" 2) Portishead - "Roads" 3) Oneohtrix Point Never - "Returnal". show: Mindhunter. headphones on, world off.

zoe: also curious if people do this for movies? short rituals?
carlos: for sure. short ritual for rewatching older scifi movies: 1) Vangelis - "Blade Runner Blues" 2) John Carpenter - "Night" 3) M83 - "I Need You". immediate nostalgia.

priya: jukebox bot, build two playlists: "In-Flight Pre-Binge" (3-song templates) and "Movie Ritual Mini". :robot_face:
jukebox: created playlist "In-Flight Pre-Binge" (3 tracks each) and "Movie Ritual Mini". links: https://open.playlist/inflight | https://open.playlist/movieritual. credit: zoe, carlos, priya, luke, nancy.

luke: tiny poll: react with :one: if you always prep a sequence before watching, :two: if never, :three: sometimes.

zoe: results so far :one: x2, :three: x2. surprising split.

nancy: pro tip: put the 3 tracks in order and play them straight through before hitting play on the show. avoids the "i'm in the mood" wobble.

carlos: thanks folks  will test this on my red-eye tonight and report back. :coffee:
